dry.name: Write code once (DRY)
dry.definition: share of code lines not covered by Type-1 (v=1), Type-2 (0.7), near-miss Type-3 (0.4) or repeated-statement micro-clones (0.3)

cohesion.name: Single responsibility / high cohesion
cohesion.definition: v = ramp(LCOM4, 1, 4); God Class (WMC>=47 and TCC<1/3) => v = 1

coupling.name: Loose coupling
coupling.definition: v = ramp(CBO, 14, 28) with CBO = |efferent U afferent| project types; plus namespace cycles (ADP) and propagation cost at repo level

dead_code.name: No dead code (YAGNI)
dead_code.definition: share of lines that are unused private members, unused locals, unreachable statements or commented-out code

magic_numbers.name: No magic numbers
magic_numbers.definition: share of code lines without unnamed numeric literals (ignoring -1,0,1,2 and const/readonly/enum/attribute/default-parameter contexts)

encapsulation.name: Encapsulation
encapsulation.definition: share of fields that are not publicly writable (CA1051)

documentation.name: Document the public API
documentation.definition: share of public API elements with an XML doc comment (CS1591)

naming.name: Meaningful, conventional names
naming.definition: v = 1 convention violation or linguistic antipattern, 0.5 too short / inconsistent, 0.25 abbreviation

consistency.name: Consistent style
consistency.definition: mean over conventions of the share following the repository majority

error_handling.name: Handle errors properly
error_handling.definition: v: empty catch 1 (0.5 commented), throw ex 1, catch-all without rethrow 0.7 (0.3 filtered), reserved exception 0.5, useless catch 0.3

reliability.name: Reliability
reliability.definition: async void, sync-over-async, lock(this), float equality
